children: TeraWulf amended its senior secured revolving credit agreement, increasing total commitments from $250 million to approximately $400 million effective October 23, 2026. The amendment also adds an uncommitted option to increase commitments by approximately $150 million, subject to lender availability and other conditions, and removes the prior $150 million letter-of-credit sublimit. The changes expand the company's available financing capacity.
